summary: Preserve extra argument evaluation and availability through arguments/rest even when there are fewer named formals.

target.notes: All argument expressions are evaluated. Extra values may be ignored by named parameters but remain observable via arguments/rest.

caveats: Do not simply drop extra argument expressions; they may have side effects.
A fixed C# signature cannot preserve arguments/rest observation without an adapter.
references: ECMAScript 2026 Language Specification EvaluateCall and FunctionDeclarationInstantiation

tests.name: extra expression still evaluated
tests.input: let x=0; function f(a){} f(1,++x); console.log(x);
